report:
Pelvic peritoneum, excision

Sections show a nodule composed of concentric layers of hyalinised, acellular fibrous tissue surrounding a central core of necrotic fat, with calcification. The features are consistent with an infarcted and detached appendix epiploica. There is no evidence of malignancy.
